|Stout adult crawbug bearing several short pins.<hr />A cowardly sort. They will try to remain at range to throw their sharp weapons. Best to rush them down and cut quick.}}

<b>Squatcraws</b> are an [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemy]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are short, rounded [[Craws|crawbugs]] with hood-like wings, wielding short pins as throwing weapons.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Squatcraws do not naturally wander; they start off resting, but begin to pursue Hornet once she gets close. They can frequently switch between flying and being grounded at any time.
Squatcraws' only attack is to launch three pins in an 80° fan formation, similar to the [[Threefold Pin]]. Whilst flying, they change the angle of throwing but still can cover an 80-degree area. Dodging between the pins is often necessary, so it is important to get used to the angles. Despite their stature, they are highly mobile and always attempt to fly out of Hornet's reach. They remain stationary when preparing to attack, so this is a good moment to get close and strike.

Squatcraws deal {{Damage|1}} with their attack and upon contact.

Whilst flying, remaining directly below them can allow Hornet to easily strike them with the Needle, as well as always dodge their Pins, since they cannot attack directly beneath themselves whilst airborne.

Whilst they are grounded, always be ready to do a small jump to avoid the lowest Pin that they throw, then capitalise on the opening.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Squatcraws have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

* Shiny, shiny, all for us!

* Swoop and scratch...

* Our caves! Our land!
* Take their treasures!

== Location ==
Squatcraws are exclusively found in eastern [[Greymoor]] near Craw Lake.
